questions.question: What was the very first item ever sold on Amazon in 1995?
questions.explanation: Jeff Bezos founded Amazon as an online bookstore; the first book sold was Douglas Hofstadter's 'Fluid Concepts and Creative Analogies'.
questions.funFact: Amazon was originally called 'Cadabra' (as in Abracadabra), but Bezos changed it after a lawyer misheard it as 'Cadaver'!
